title: Build a golf course. Blame the designer. Little Links Golf Lite beta + Steam in 2027.
author: Three_Tails_Studio
selftext:
We’re making **Little Links Golf**, a cozy golf course sim coming to **Steam in 2027**. Build your dream course, run the club, then find out who put that bunker there. Oh right. You did.

While we work on the full PC game, we’re looking for testers for **Little Links Golf Lite**, our browser beta. It’s a small proof of concept with bugs we’d prefer you found before anyone else does. It doesn’t reflect the full PC game’s visuals or scope.

Want in? Request a beta key at [**threetailsstudios.com**](https://threetailsstudios.com/). We’re letting people in a few at a time.

— Three Tails Studio

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: Eventually. Our focus right now is the PC version. If we find success we will port to other devices.
